title: guard.config.json — the GUARD run contract
description: Compiled from the six wizard answers. Written provisional at P0 (Wizard I: W1, W2, W4-belief, W6), finalized at P3 (Wizard II: W3, W5, verified net_status). The executing agent follows it exactly (Constitution rule 9). Validate with: python3 scripts/guard_lint.py config guard.config.json

status.description: provisional = Wizard I only (pre-P3); final = all six answers. P4 and later require final.

allow.description: W2 — glob allow-list. Nothing outside it is scanned or touched.

deny.description: Never scanned, never touched. Generated/vendored paths enumerated at P1 entry land here.

max_tier.description: W3 — highest tier the plan may contain. Required when status=final.

proof_rung_ceiling.description: Highest rung the run will be asked to reach (from the W3 profile). Required when status=final.

approval_cadence.description: W5 — per-task = approve every task; per-batch = approve batches; per-t2-change = batches plus every T2+ individually (Balanced default); plan-only = run after Gate B, report at end. Required when status=final.

delivery_base.description: The branch P5 task branches are cut from and P0 commits to (e.g. "main", or the integration branch name when delivery=integration-branch).

frozen_modules.description: Scanned — findings are reported at Gate A — but no change to them may be planned. (Contrast scope.deny: never scanned at all.)

net_status.description: Per-module VERIFIED net (post-P0 proof), not the W4 belief. none = frozen except net-building; typecheck or unproven tests = escalate findings one tier.

net_status_claimed.description: The user's W4 belief, kept beside the verified net_status; a discrepancy is a Gate A finding.
